issues.description: The solution implementation of ExcellenceLand defines the getter for the boolean attribute with a parameter: isExcellentEnough(boolean strictCheck). The problem statement explicitly requires adding public getters for all attributes (i.e., standard no-argument getters). A getter with a parameter does not match the required no-arg getter pattern and will confuse students and break automated checks that expect a no-argument isExcellentEnough() (or getExcellentEnough()) method.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the solution's boolean getter to a no-argument public method that returns the attribute value. For example: public boolean isExcellentEnough() { return excellentEnough; } (or public boolean getExcellentEnough()). Alternatively, provide an overloaded no-arg getter in addition to any helper methods to preserve the intended API.
